summary: Completed testing of Plant Overview tab and DateRangeFilter features for Digital Twin MVP. Backend: All 13 API tests passed (100%). Frontend: Plant Overview renders with ~45 equipment pieces, 3D isometric visualization with Canvas 2D, view mode buttons (Isometric/Top/Front), flow animation toggle, 7-category legend, and clickable equipment for analytics drill-down. DateRangeFilter appears on all 5 analytics tabs (Water Balance, NRW, Demand, Assets, Quality) with 5 presets (1H, 6H, 24H, 7D, 30D) and custom datetime inputs. Tab bar shows all 7 tabs correctly.

minor.issue: External URL may have cold-start delay (10-30 seconds)

Plant Overview uses Canvas 2D with isometric projection to render ~45 equipment pieces with labels, water levels from live sensor data, and clickable regions for analytics drill-down.
